# `ext::reactive_graph` — declaration reference

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/reactive_graph.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: support/implementation data. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Executable graph kernel on native Linux x86_64 CPU output from the GPU compiler. Dynamic dependency replacement, equality-aware memo scheduling, batched effects, fixed arena budgets and scope disposal. A single manual Graph owner; IDs may not outlive its close. Does not own user values or captured callbacks and is not yet a Signal<T>/Memo<T> API or a UI toolkit. Focused tests include 1000 full-evaluator model batches and sparse work with 10000 source/effect pairs. Other targets, allocation-failure injection, typed destruction and formal verification remain open.
